observations: Blue manual air pump with a white foot pedal.
A black power cord with a red plug is attached.
The pump features a metal air valve at the end of the handle.
The handle has a red label with white text, but the text is illegible.
The item is resting on a green artificial turf background.

claims.evidence: Requires physical force to operate; no video shows it working.

claims.claim: within a few strokes air gets inflated
claims.evidence: Requires a pressure test or video of inflation.
Material and weight cannot be determined from the photo.

risks.risk: The pump may not inflate tires or may leak air.
risks.proof: A video showing the pump inflating a tire or a pressure gauge reading.

risks.risk: The foot pedal may be broken or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the pedal being pressed and released.

risks.risk: The air valve may be damaged or leaky.
risks.proof: A video showing the valve being checked for leaks.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the pump being used to inflate a tire.
Video of the foot pedal being pressed and released.
Close-up photo of the air valve and the red label on the handle.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
